issues.where: the skeleton on the shelf edge
issues.what: the ribcage is a collapsed heap of shredded, smeared bone sheets with broken, stretched geometry, browned like the weed; -a has a clean, pale, articulated skeleton lying along the edge, skull to hind legs
issues.fix: rebuild the skeleton as intact articulated bone: separate ribs, clear spine, skull and limbs, pale bleached bone lit warm from the low sun

issues.where: the far cliffs and the sky
issues.what: the cliffs are a low, distant, even band under a big pink-to-lilac sky; in -a they are tall, near, sunlit cliffs with caves and overhangs that fill the top of frame, under a thin pale sky
issues.fix: bring the cliffs much closer and taller, cut the sky back to a thin strip, and keep the warm side light on the cliff faces

issues.where: the lake surface, middle and far
issues.what: the water carries no mirror reflection of the cliffs and no rings of ripples; it is a flat pink-grey sheen with a dark blank band; -a shows a strong golden reflection of the cliffs and wide concentric ripple rings
issues.fix: reflect the sunlit cliffs in the still water and add the wide ripple rings across the middle distance

issues.what: the sunken cliff wall seen through clear water is gone; the shelf edge falls into smooth wavy turquoise bands of sand that look like a different, shallow place
issues.fix: show a steep underwater rock wall dropping into deep blue-green water, with the faint vertical shapes in the depths

issues.where: the shelf in the foreground and left
issues.what: the rock reads as a flat procedural texture of tan patches under orange strands, with a pink sky sheen over the left half; -a has a raised, lumpy travertine ledge with green-gold algae and soft depth of field
issues.fix: give the ledge relief and wet travertine form, tone the weed toward gold-olive, remove the pink wash and restore the shallow focus falloff

issues.where: the far water at the foot of the cliffs
issues.what: small white sticks stand out of the water near the horizon with nothing like them in -a, and the low mist on the water is thinner
issues.fix: remove the white objects and thicken the low mist lying on the far water

issues.what: the water is a muddy brown-mauve with dull reflections and long horizontal streaks; -a is a cool grey water with bright broken orange reflections of the cliffs and many crisp concentric ripple rings
issues.fix: cool the water toward grey-blue, brighten and break up the orange cliff reflections, and add the concentric rings spreading out from the swell

issues.where: the cliffs and cave behind the lake
issues.what: the cliff wall is pulled much closer and fills the top third; in -a it sits further back above a scree slope and a mist bank, with sky-free top and lit pale crags left
issues.fix: push the cliffs back, open the scree slope and shoreline at their foot, and lay a deeper mist bank on the far water

issues.where: the swell and the fins around it
issues.what: the swell is a smooth dark dome with no breaking water and no ripple train; fins are fewer and far right, missing the lit fin centre-right and the spread across the lake
issues.fix: break the water over the swell with highlights and spreading rings, and scatter the fins across the lake as in -a

issues.what: the skin is smooth and evenly lit, without the scuffs, scars and warm rim light seen in -a
issues.fix: add skin wear and marks and a warm rim of low sun on the tops of the necks
